name: Health Check Up
author: Glutoblop
description: Shows a translucent segment on the health bar previewing how much the next food regeneration tick will heal.

changelog.0.1.3: Removed the radial cooldown icon and its settings. The health bar previews how much the next food regeneration tick will heal.
changelog.0.1.2: Mod Settings button in the pause menu: change this plugin's settings in game (one tab per plugin).
changelog.0.1.0: Initial release: regen cooldown ring, heal-amount preview on the health bar.
